title: Backstop Backlog Schema v1
description: Schema for BACKLOG.yml — the ordered list of directive IDs that constitutes the project backlog. Position in the list IS priority. First item is highest priority. Reordering the file is reprioritizing.

directives.description: Ordered list of directive IDs. Position = priority. First = highest.

title.description: Human-readable title (denormalized for readability, source of truth is the directive file)

bundles.description: Ordered list of bundle IDs not yet homed by a directive. Bundles are expressions of intent (founder ruling 2026-07-26): every bundle appears here from creation until a directive cites it as source, regardless of maturity. Position = priority within the intent tier.

title.description: Denormalized title; source of truth is the bundle file

enforcement.position-is-priority: No priority field exists. Moving an item up or down in the list IS the prioritization action.
enforcement.all-active-directives-listed: Every directive with status queued or active should appear in the backlog. Done directives may be removed or kept for history.
enforcement.no-duplicates: Each directive ID appears at most once in the list.
enforcement.all-bundles-listed: Every bundle appears either as a directive source or in the bundles section — unhomed intent is never invisible. A bundle leaves this section only by being cited by a directive or reaching a terminal state.
